en:
Because of you,
I was able to enjoy my time.

I wonder why... When I am with you,
I feel I can become a better maid.

Well then, shall we walk to the
dormitory together?
This was a productive day thanks to you.

If you would like, please spend time
with me again.
Let us return to our dormitory.

I recommend you to polish your skills
more as a man.

If it was any other woman, I cannot
imagine what they would have done.
You wished to spend your time like this?
I will be heading back alone.
